outcome: radiological monkey wrench appearance at the proximal femur
cohort: Two unrelated Egyptian patients presenting with characteristic features of Desbuquois dysplasia type 1 (DBQD1).
finding: Whole-exome sequencing revealed homozygous CANT1 gene mutations in two Egyptian patients with DBQD1, demonstrating phenotypic variability and expanding the disorder's spectrum to include hypoplastic scrotum and hypospadias.
